description.narrative:
The Joint Programme (JP) is based on lessons learned, experiences and previous joint efforts carried out by the UN agencies in close collaboration with national actors at different levels of the Bosnian society and within different parts of society. The Programme connects to the existing Gender Equality Law and will contribute to the fourth Gender Action Plan (GAP 2023-2027) by focusing on three strategic accelerators and by striving to achieve the following impact goals:
i) Eliminating violence against women and girls: Goal: By 2028, women and girls experience less violence and discrimination.
ii) Empowering women economically : Goal: By 2028, more women and girls, in all their diversity have access to productive employment and decent work.
iii) Elevating women in gender-responsive governance and leadership and gender-mainstreaming laws and policies: Goal: By 2028, more women and girls effectively participate in leadership and decision-making at all levels in public, economic and political life.
Within each one of the above stated impact goals, the Programme identifies several outcomes, and under each outcome, outputs and activities are included. To measure the results, indicators are formulated. Detailed results and resource frameworks (RRF) are identified for each one of the three impact areas. The RRFs follow the template for Joint Programmes defined by the UN. To measure the results under each indicator, baselines are identified. Some baselines will be defined during the inception period.

Insatsen är ett gemensamt program mellan FN-organen UNICEF, UNDP, UNWomen och UNFPA inom jämställdhetsområdet i Bosnien. Programmet bidrar till att nå definierade resultat i Sveriges strategi för reformsamarbetet med västra Balkan och Turkiet 2021-2027 inom följande områden: i) mänskliga rättigheter, demokrati, rättsstatens principer och jämställdhet, ii) fredliga och inkluderande samhällen och iii) inkluderande ekonomisk utveckling.
Övergripande syfte är att bidra till att: * avskaffa våld mot kvinnor och flickor * stärka kvinnors ekonomiska egenmakt * främja och förtydliga kvinnors roll och deltagande i samhällsstyrning och ledarskap på olika nivåer i samhället

The contribution is a joint program (JP) between the UN agencies UNICEF, UNDP, UNWomen and UNFPA within gender equality in Bosnia and Hercegovina. The program contributes to the strategic objectives within Sweden's strategy for reform cooperation with the Western Balkans and Turkey 2021-2027, in the areas of i) human rights, democracy, the rule of law and gender equality, ii) peaceful and inclusive societies and iii) inclusive economic development.
The overarching objective of the joint program (JP) is to contribute to: * eliminating violence against women and girls * empowering women economically * elevating women in gender-responsive governance and leadership and gender-mainstreaming laws and policies
